issues.quote: **Escalation:** past N minutes in store hours, it moves to the team view and texts the named role [E6]. Owner alerts only where connected, one per episode [E33].
issues.concern: This adds a time-driven trigger and none of its inputs exist. (1) Store hours per department need a source. (2) The 'named role' has no user mapping, because getUserEmailsAndContacts filters by department, not by role. (3) A text that fires on elapsed time, with no inbound event, needs a scheduled job, and there isn't one. Handover alerts are still a TODO. The doc also dropped 'failures logged' from the r1 resolution. A rep's phone that never gets the text fails silently, and the dealer finds out first. 'Moves to the team view' also means nothing at the launch state, where the team view is the only view.

issues.quote: **Unanswered:** SMS and chat, a customer message after a Vini handoff or flag, or once a human is active, with no human reply since; calls, a missed call not returned (setting) [E31]; email, no human reply since. What Vini fully answers stays out.
issues.concern: This is the queue definition and also the wait-time metric, and three of its terms have no signal behind them. 'Flag' is undefined: is it a Vini-created action item, a needs-attention marker, or something else? 'Handoff' and 'human is active' map to humanTransferPhase, which is traced for SMS only. Chat runs in a separate chat-service with its own session state. 'Human reply' needs an actor. has_unread already treats AI sends and manual replies the same, and Vini outbound calls are not a human returning a call. On a Vini rooftop the AI answers inbound calls, so 'missed call' has to mean something like a failed transfer to a human or a promised callback. Nothing names that record.

issues.ask: For each channel, name the signal that opens an episode, for example 'SMS: humanTransferPhase PENDING or Vini action item created', and define 'human reply' as a send whose actor is a console user. Define 'missed call' as an unanswered transfer or a promised callback, or move it to an open question with the call-record source to check.

issues.quote: **Mine** is the CRM's assigned salesperson (sales) or the scheduler or DMS advisor (service), read CRM/DMS-first; never Spyne's round-robin pick or a takeover claimant [PM] [E43].
issues.concern: There is no data contract for the owner once we read it. A filterable 'mine' and an action-item join need the owner stored next to the lead the team list pre-queries. That means a stored copy with a source and a synced-at time. Without it, every list load becomes a cross-service join. The doc also doesn't say how fresh the owner is, webhook or poll. If a manager reassigns a lead in VinSolutions and we poll nightly, the rep sees the wrong queue all day.
issues.ask: Add to Open question 1 or 2: the owner is a read-only copy on the lead, with source, provider id and synced-at, refreshed by webhook where the provider offers one. State the staleness the floor can accept.
